source.title: Outlays of the U.S. Government — Independent Agencies Remainder and Total

unit_note: USD millions. Dots mark no transactions and (**) marks amounts below $500,000 in absolute value; both marks are omitted from the numeric cells. Page 21 Independent Agencies remainder (SEC, Smithsonian, TVA, Other) and Total--Independent Agencies. SEC prints Prior FYTD Applicable Receipts of 1 (54 = 1 + 53 exact) and (**) in current periods; TVA current periods close at tol=1 (6,297 + 493 = 6,790 vs 6,791). Net outlays 3,989 / 3,989 / 3,829 match Table 3 (page 8).
